name: Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Summon a Fire Elemental
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): A Fire Elemental appears in the space nearest you; it obeys you while you concentrate, up to an hour.

summary: Once a day, summon an Fire Elemental that obeys you (Concentration, up to 1 hour).
text: With the brazier in hand, take a Magic action to call forth a Fire Elemental into the unoccupied space nearest the brazier. The elemental regards you and your companions as allies and carries out your orders. It remains for up to 1 hour, provided you hold Concentration on it just as you would for a spell. After that the brazier is spent until the next dawn.
